title: Grade 4 ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — Termly Exam #5 (Term 2)

pages.quiz:
ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — TERMLY EXAM #5 (TERM 2)
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 60 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which item may be used together with water in washing a heavy najasa? (1 mark)
   A. Paint
   B. Sugar
   C. Clean soil
   D. Salt

2. Which verse says Allah sends down pure water from the sky? (1 mark)
   A. Qur'an 110:1
   B. Qur'an 112:1
   C. Qur'an 1:1
   D. Qur'an 25:48

3. Which of these is a najasa? (1 mark)
   A. Sweat
   B. Urine
   C. Clean water
   D. Milk

4. What does "twahara" mean? (1 mark)
   A. Fasting
   B. Purity
   C. Prayer
   D. Charity

5. What do we say at the start of wudhu? (1 mark)
   A. Goodbye
   B. Amin
   C. Nothing
   D. Bismillah

6. Kamal made wudhu at 6 a.m. and only ate lunch. Is wudhu still valid? (1 mark)
   A. No
   B. Only if he rinses
   C. Yes
   D. Only if he sleeps

7. What must a boy cover at the least during prayer? (1 mark)
   A. Only the face
   B. From navel to knees
   C. Nothing
   D. Only the feet

8. What is the Qibla? (1 mark)
   A. A prayer mat
   B. A call to prayer
   C. The direction of the Kaaba
   D. A garment

9. What is qiyam? (1 mark)
   A. Prostration
   B. Bowing
   C. Sitting
   D. Standing

10. What is tartib? (1 mark)
   A. Praying fast
   B. Doing the pillars in order
   C. Praying without wudhu
   D. Making dua

11. How many sujud are in each rak'ah? (1 mark)
   A. Four
   B. One
   C. Two
   D. Three

12. What is ruku? (1 mark)
   A. Standing
   B. Prostrating
   C. Sitting
   D. Bowing

13. In the Prophet's story, the man gave water to which animal? (1 mark)
   A. A dog
   B. A goat
   C. A horse
   D. A cow

14. Which is a way of showing kindness to a working donkey? (1 mark)
   A. Overloading it
   B. Beating it
   C. Giving water and rest
   D. Leaving it in the sun

15. What is a kofia? (1 mark)
   A. A shoe
   B. A belt
   C. A cap
   D. A coat

16. Which of these should be avoided? (1 mark)
   A. Shoes
   B. Neat school uniform
   C. Boys dressing to look like girls
   D. Clean clothes

17. What does Qur'an 49:6 tell us about news? (1 mark)
   A. Change it
   B. Share it quickly
   C. Check it first
   D. Ignore it

18. Which is a negative use of media? (1 mark)
   A. Calling grandmother
   B. Studying
   C. Spreading rumours
   D. Listening to Qur'an

19. What does Qur'an 93:10 say about the one who asks? (1 mark)
   A. Laugh at him
   B. Do not drive him away
   C. Ignore him
   D. Shout at him

20. What did the Prophet say about cutting and selling firewood? (1 mark)
   A. It is forbidden
   B. It is only for the poor
   C. It is shameful
   D. It is better than asking people

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
21. List three rules for staying safe online. (3 marks)

22. Explain what a Muslim child should do before sharing a message. (4 marks)

23. Name the three types of najasaat. (3 marks)

24. State three things that do not nullify wudhu. (3 marks)

25. Name three types of Muslim clothing worn in Kenya. (3 marks)

26. Explain the difference between a condition and a pillar of swalah. (3 marks)

27. Give one example of each type of najasa. (3 marks)

28. Explain the hadith "The upper hand is better than the lower hand". (3 marks)

29. State two ways a child can earn or save money safely. (2 marks)

30. Name three types of media and give one example of each. (3 marks)
pages.answers:
ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — TERMLY EXAM #5 (TERM 2) · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. C — Clean soil
   One of the washings uses soil.

2. D — Qur'an 25:48
   Surah Al-Furqan 25:48.

3. B — Urine
   Urine must be washed off before prayer.

4. B — Purity
   Twahara is the Arabic word for purity.

5. D — Bismillah
   Bismillah begins good deeds.

6. C — Yes
   Eating does not break wudhu.

7. B — From navel to knees
   This is the minimum.

8. C — The direction of the Kaaba
   Muslims face the Kaaba.

9. D — Standing
   Qiyam means standing.

10. B — Doing the pillars in order
   It means order.

11. C — Two
   Each rak'ah has two sujud.

12. D — Bowing
   Ruku is bowing.

13. A — A dog
   Allah forgave him for it.

14. C — Giving water and rest
   Working animals need care.

15. C — A cap
   A kofia is a cap.

16. C — Boys dressing to look like girls
   Islam asks each to dress appropriately.

17. C — Check it first
   Verify before acting.

18. C — Spreading rumours
   Rumours can hurt.

19. B — Do not drive him away
   We should be kind.

20. D — It is better than asking people
   Recorded in Al-Bukhari.

SECTION B
----
21. (3 marks)
   Answer: Never share passwords or address, ask parents' permission, tell an adult about anything uncomfortable.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

22. (4 marks)
   Answer: Check whether it is true and kind, and useful and safe. If not sure, do not share, as Qur'an 49:6 says to verify news.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for true, 1 mark for kind, 1 mark for useful or safe, 1 mark for the verse or verifying.

23. (3 marks)
   Answer: Mukhaffafah (light), mutawassitah (medium) and mughalladha (heavy).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

24. (3 marks)
   Answer: Eating, drinking, talking, laughing quietly, sweating.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

25. (3 marks)
   Answer: Kanzu, kofia, hijab or headscarf, buibui, long dress.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

26. (3 marks)
   Answer: A condition is met before the prayer starts, such as wudhu. A pillar is part of the prayer, such as ruku.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for condition, 1 mark for pillar, 1 mark for an example.

27. (3 marks)
   Answer: Light: urine of a baby boy on milk only; medium: urine, stool, blood or vomit; heavy: dog or pig saliva.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each example.

28. (3 marks)
   Answer: The giving hand is better than the receiving hand. A Muslim should try to work and give rather than depend on others.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for giver better, 1 mark for work, 1 mark for the lesson.

29. (2 marks)
   Answer: Chores for a small reward with permission, and saving in a box or school scheme.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

30. (3 marks)
   Answer: Print: newspaper; broadcast: radio; internet: video website.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each type with example.
